newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down, but downside seen limited.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down, but downside seen limited.

text.p: Brent crude futures were lower in Asia late on Wednesday afternoon after NYMEX dropped more than 20 cents on bearish API data, but brokers said downside was now limited.
July Brent was last traded on SIMEX at $18.80 per barrel, down 10 cents from London, which shed 62 cents to settle overnight at $18.90.
"I would not be surprised to see the market come back up from here," a broker said. "It was an over reaction on the downside yesterday."
NYMEX July crude dropped 65 cents in New York as news U.S. supported a roll over of Iraq's oil-for-food deal caught the market at a technically vulnerable point.
ACCESS extended the downside by more than 20 cents after bearish API data.
"I am surprised people were not expecting Iraq oil to be rolled over, but the news just triggered some stops...the API news is in the market at these levels," a broker said.
